description: The Drupal paid-services board returned HTTP 200. That makes its original buyer posts available to check for a current paid export or migration request with a testable deliverable. Commercial feedback reports zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains inconclusive. Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
